chrome-parity pairs icons by basename including the local hash suffix → permanent false ICON deltas; compare on the un-hashed stem.

Sub-pixel: Chrome LayoutUnit (1/64px) accumulation across different DOM nesting can move a band top by ~0.05px and flip the pixel snap of everything below by 1px (360 form block: 13.8k differing px → 0 after a −0.05px margin). A shift-searching region diff (capture/regiondiff.mjs: best dx/dy in ±2) separates this from real geometry error instantly.
